main_text.p: lapidei erant facti ipsis in circuitu, Hebr. טור, Ezech.46. v.23. מִלְּרַע לִנְדָבְכִיא [?] Sub ordinibus lapideis iftis, Ibidem.
דבל דְּבֵלָה f. Palatha, Massa ficuum, 1.Sam.30.12. Constr. דִּבְלַת תְּאֵנִים Palatha ficuum, 2.Reg.20. v.7. Plural. דְּבֵלִים, 1.Sam.25.18.

דבק Adhaesit, Cohaesit; Conjunctus, Congluti-natus fuit: Constr. cum Praepof. אַל, עִם, אַחֲרֵי, ל, ב. Praeter. וְדָבַק בְּאִשְׁתּוֹ Et adhaerebit uxori suae, Genef.2.24. Cum Affixo Futur. תִּדְבַּקֵנִי הָרָעָה Adhaereat mihi malum, Gen.19.19. Chald.Partic.Plur. דְּבַקִין Cohaerentes, Dan.2.43. Pyh.Futur. יִדְבָּקוּ Conglutinentur, Job.38.38. & 41.8. Hiph. הִדְבִּיק Adhaerefcere fecit, Agglutinavit, Conglutinavit: Perfecutus, Affecutus fuit: Praet. הִדְבַּקְתִּי Feceram ut adhaereret, Jer.13. v.11. הִדְבִּיקוּהוּ Affecuti sunt eum, 2.Sam.1. v.6. Hoph. Partic. מֻדְבָּק Adhaerere facta, Psal.22.16.
דָּבֵק m. Adhaerens, Conjunctus: דָּבֵק מֵאָח Conjunctior fratre, Prov.18.24. Foem. דְּבֵקָה Conjuncta, 2.Par.3.12.
דֶּבֶק m. Junctura, Commissura, Fertumen, Glutinum, quo aliquid Conjungitur, Jesa.41.7. Plural. דְּבָקִים Commissura, 2.Par.18.33. 1.Reg.22.34.

דבך Locutus, Elocutus est: Construitur cum Praepositionibus ל, אל, על. Particip. דָּבַר Eloquor, Exod.6.29. Plur. דִּבְּרִים Loquuntur, Num.36.5. Constr. דִּבְרֵי Psal.5.6. Foem.Plur. דִּבְּרוֹת Loquuntur, Num.27. v.7. Partic.Pahul, דָּבָר Dictum, Prov.25.11. Infin. דַּבֵּר In loqui te, Quum loquutus fueris, Psalm.61.6. Niph. נִדְבַּר Assiduè, Frequenter loqui, vel praedicare, dictitare: Obloqui, Colloqui: Praet. נִדְבְּרוּ Frequenter loquuntur, Mal.3.16. נִדְבַּרְנוּ עָלֶיךָ Oblocuti sumus tibi, Mal.3.13. Part. Plural. הַנִּדְבָּרִים בְּךָ Assiduè loquentes contra te, Ezech.33. v.30. Kimchi scribit ad hunc locū, לְשׁוֹן דִּבּוּר שֶׁהוּא קָשׁוּר

page.notes: Hebrew forms are copied as far as legible; vowel points in small print may be imperfect. The Hebrew phrase at the foot of Ezech.33 v.30 is cut off at the line end on the scan. Hebrew phrase after "Ibidem" (מִלְּרַע לִנְדָבְכִיא) is uncertain and marked [?].
